nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) recording token balances; modified directly in transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spenders' allowances; decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Private mapping counting how many times an address has sold; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist checked in ensure to bypass sale conditions.
Minimum transfer amount allowed, set only by owner via init().
Maximum transfer amount allowed, set only by owner via init().
Maximum number of sales allowed per address, set only by owner via init().
Address exempt from sale restrictions; settable only by owner via setTradeAddress.
Private privileged address set to msg.sender in the constructor; gates all administrative functions.
Public total token supply, minted entirely to the owner in the constructor.
Public token name string set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor.
Public constant decimals (18) used in supply and init scaling.
Constant address of the Uniswap V2 router pre-approved for the full allowance in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal whitelist/restriction check; computes the Uniswap pair address and validates via condition().
Public payable transfer entry point; checks allowance, calls ensure(), mutates balances unchecked and bumps _onSaleNum.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] unconditionally (no zero-first check).
Internal sale-restriction logic using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum; returns false when all configured to zero.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker/owner supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with decimal scaling.
Owner-only airdrop loop computing total via unchecked multiplication and updating balances in a loop.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress exemption.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair-address computation via init-code hash.
Payable constructor initializing metadata, supply, owner, balances and infinite UNI router allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as the transfer initiator, approver and owner check subject.
Arbitrary low-level delegatecall in delegate() executed in the token's storage context.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender becomes _from in transferFrom, allowing self-authorized movement of funds when transferFrom is called directly.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) for whitelist/restriction validation.
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
ensure compares _from/_to against the privileged owner address to bypass restrictions.
ensure reads tradeAddress from the whitelist check.
ensure reads the canSale whitelist mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
condition reads _saleNum to cap the number of allowed sales.
condition reads _minSale to enforce a minimum transfer size.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum transfer size.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
transferFrom executes unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom executes unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing a privileged delegatecall.
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b) giving arbitrary code control over the token storage.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
transfer passes msg.sender as the source of the forwarded transferFrom call.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting permanent privileges to the deployer.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and debits msg.sender balances.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow checks.
batchSend debits msg.sender and credits each _tos entry in balanceOf.
init requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale parameters.
init sets _minSale from the token parameter.
init sets _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init sets _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
setTradeAddress writes the restricted-sale-exempt tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before writing tradeAddress.
constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply (whole supply to owner).
constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1) (infinite router allowance).
constructor computes totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
constructor initializes the owner state variable.
constructor writes the name state variable.
constructor writes the symbol state variable.
constructor reads decimals to scale the initial supply.
constructor pre-approves the constant UNI router address.
pairFor result is assigned to the local _UNI inside ensure.
transferFrom._from parameter flows into balance and ensure checks.
transferFrom._to parameter flows into the recipient balance update.
transferFrom._value parameter drives allowance, balance and sale-count updates.
ensure._UNI local is compared against _from within ensure.
delegate.a is the target address of the delegatecall.
delegate.b is the calldata passed to the delegatecall.
batchSend._tos array drives the airdrop loop and balance credits.
batchSend._value is the per-recipient amount and multiplication operand.
batchSend.total local results from the unchecked multiplication.
constructor._supply parameter defines totalSupply.
constructor._name parameter is stored in name.
constructor._symbol parameter is stored in symbol.
transfer._to parameter is forwarded to transferFrom.
transfer._value parameter is forwarded to transferFrom.

Per-recipient amount is only used inside batchSend arithmetic; fold into the function node.
Local total is the direct product of the unchecked multiplication.
Supply argument is only consumed by the constructor initialization.
